name: Unitree H1
summary: Unitree's first full-size humanoid (1.8 m, 47 kg) for locomotion research; 4-DOF arms, hands optional.

germany.statusNote: Funduino sells the H1-S from its cart (105,910 € incl. VAT, "with you in 14 working days"); Generation Robots, MYBOTSHOP and QUADRUPED Robotics quote on request; OpenELAB lists the H1 at 109,198.95 € but sold out, shipping from China.

priceEur.note: Funduino, H1-S (5 DoF per leg, 4 per arm: the H1), incl. VAT; 89,000 € net.

germany.leadTime: 14 working days (Funduino H1-S); 5 days after order (MYBOTSHOP); 21 days after order (QUADRUPED H1-S); on request (Generation Robots)

sellers.name: Generation Robots (Génération Robots, with Generation Robots GmbH in Berlin)
sellers.note: H1 / H1-2 page with a 'from' price of EUR 93,496 excl. VAT for the page; cart disabled, 'delivery times on request'. The shop calls it "a prototype for research and development, not compatible or certified for current or industrial tasks".

sellers.name: MYBOTSHOP GmbH
sellers.note: Price on request; "must be ordered, deliverable 5 days after order". MYBOTSHOP states that sales run through its partner shop QUADRUPED Robotics (quadruped.de).

sellers.name: Unitree Robotics
sellers.note: Unitree store: 'contact us for the real price'.

sellers.name: QUADRUPED Robotics (quadruped.de)
sellers.note: Listed as "Unitree H1-S"; price on request; "must be ordered, deliverable 21 days after order". The separate H1-M page (from 28.12.2026) says the H1-M has 6 DoF per leg and 7 per arm against 5 and 4 for the H1-S, but keeps the H1 weight (47 kg) in its table.

sellers.name: Funduino GmbH
sellers.note: H1-S 105,910 € and H1-M 142,800 € incl. VAT, cart enabled, "Available to order – with you in 14 working days."; one year warranty for business buyers.

sellers.name: OpenELAB (OpenELAB Technology Ltd., Shenzhen; office in Garching bei München)
sellers.note: "Ausverkauft" (sold out); ships from China; 12-month limited warranty; the page does not say whether OpenELAB is an authorised Unitree dealer.

specs.label: Computing
specs.value: Intel Core i5 (platform) + Intel Core i7 (user development); optional Orin NX

capabilities.sdk: Intel Core i7 user development computer
notes: Arm payload not published for the H1.
No IP rating or runtime published.

images.alt: Unitree H1 humanoid in a grey Unitree shirt, full body, one arm raised

evidence.task: Walks and runs on complex terrain for locomotion research

openQuestions: Runtime: Unitree's H1 manual (page images only) says about 2 h; sellers say 2–4 h; no HTML page states it.
Whether the H1-M sold by QUADRUPED Robotics and Funduino is the H1-2: its joint counts match the H1-2, its listed weight is the H1's.
Unitree's H1 manual (page images only) says to use it in an open, flat, unobstructed environment, not on gravel, in rain or dust; that limits the rough-ground claim.
